description: The trail goes west to the bowl below Mt. Muir and Muir SW2. The use of e-bikes is prohibited on this trail.
directions: From Elkford, travel north on the Elk River FSR until the 146 km road marker. The trailhead is near here, and heads east. There is a recreation site directly across the bridge that crosses the Elk River on the left.
title: Weary Creek Trail
